2026_01_BAL_IND.headline: Baltimore must replace interior defensive force while its offense tests Indianapolis in space
2026_01_BAL_IND.paragraph1: The Ravens ruled Nnamdi Madubuike and Teddye Buchanan out, with Devontez Walker questionable, while the Colts list Austin Ajiake as questionable and otherwise enter relatively clean. Baltimore’s defensive absences give Indianapolis a real avenue to test the middle of the front. The Ravens can offset that vulnerability by making the Colts defend Lamar Jackson’s movement, option looks and layered throws across the field, forcing Indianapolis to choose between extra bodies near the box and lighter coverage numbers behind them.
2026_01_BAL_IND.model_rationale: Baltimore’s offensive multiplicity can create more assignment stress than Indianapolis can comfortably absorb, provided the Ravens avoid letting their defensive absences dictate game flow.
